title: Public Repository State and Release Boundary Reconciliation v0.1
objective: Reconcile the documented private pre-release boundary with the observed PUBLIC repository, active main branch protection, current remote history, local branch divergence, release-check semantics, and exposure-risk evidence without changing GitHub or publication state.
acceptance: Reconcile canonical release documents with the observed PUBLIC repository and active main branch protection.
Audit current remote exposure, tracked release materials, Git history risk evidence, local versus origin/main divergence, and release-check semantics using read-only operations.
Distinguish historical private-preview decisions from the current public repository state without erasing audit history.
Treat the observed PUBLIC repository and active branch protection as external state evidence, not as authorization for additional release actions.
Keep npm publication, GitHub Release, public launch, deployment, marketing, hosted/commercial availability claims, permission changes, and repository-control changes unauthorized.
Return a bounded go/no-go recommendation and at most one next Goal after reconciliation.
